metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the trial of pages, the sentence you wrote down at home, and the Guildhall news after the play.

yesterday: You named the morning a trial, before you go into the country.
Nick stopped at her entrance and called her careful. Of the man she has a name and a face across a hall.
Five men are condemned for levying war. You told John you go on Monday.
John knows you go on Monday. You said, on these.
